title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 11C–11D: Opinions about films
subtitle: Words for talking about films, actors and what you think of them

words.def: a short text in which you say what you think about a film, a book or a restaurant
words.sent: Ashley wrote a very positive ___ of the film Roma.

words.def: to tell someone that something is good and that they should try it
words.sent: I can ___ this film, but only watch it if you enjoy sad films!

words.def: unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped
words.sent: I watched it on Netflix, but I was ___.

words.def: not interesting; it makes you want to do something else
words.sent: I found the story a bit ___.

words.def: full of action, so you want to know what happens next
words.sent: All the characters just do ordinary things and nothing ___ happens.

words.def: something you want to know more about; it keeps your attention
words.sent: I thought it was a very ___ film, but it was also very sad.

words.def: unhappy; a film that makes you want to cry is ___
words.sent: It’s a ___ film and the ending made me cry.

words.def: very, very bad
words.sent: Don’t go to see it. It’s ___!

words.def: not special or unusual; normal
words.sent: All the characters just do ___ things.

words.def: the last part of a film or a story
words.sent: It’s a sad film and the ___ made me cry.

words.def: what happens in a film or a book
words.sent: The acting was good, but I found the ___ a bit boring.

words.def: the work of actors who play people in a film or play
words.sent: The ___ was very good, especially the actors who play the maid and the mother.

words.def: the part of a person in a film that an actor plays
words.sent: She plays the ___ of a maid who works for a middle-class family.

words.def: a person in a film or a book
words.sent: All the ___ in the film just do ordinary things.

words.def: the person who tells the actors what to do when a film is made
words.sent: The film is by the Mexican ___ Alfonso Cuarón.

words.def: things in a film that look real but are made with computers
words.sent: John thinks the ___ in the film were good.

words.def: a building where you go to watch films on a big screen
words.sent: I saw Roma at the ___ last year.

words.def: to like doing or watching something and have a good time
words.sent: Did you ___ it? — Yes, it was a good concert.

words.def: a woman whose job is to clean and cook in someone’s house
words.sent: She plays the role of a ___ who works for a middle-class family.

words.def: with no colours, only black, grey and white
words.sent: It’s a sad film and it’s in ___.
